title: No silent work: every job shows in the queue (umbrella)
description: Fabio 2026-10-12: every job the user (or Cosmo / an outside agent) starts must show itself. GPU work goes in the generation queue + status bar; non-GPU work (downloads, uploads, CPU / ffmpeg / file copies) goes in the queue panel with a progress bar; a job with no real progress number shows the moving left-to-right sweep, never nothing; a new job entering the queue flashes a gradient on the right edge of the UI. Rule: .claude/rules/dos_and_donts.md section 'Every action shows itself' (MPI-1100). Members and phase order: this card's plan.md.
